title: Dimension shifting for normalized coherent cohomology maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, let $A(F,q)=\operatorname{Ext}^q(\underline{\mathbb Z},F_{\mathrm{ab}})$ on the Zariski site, in the standard large Ext universe [def-pc-ext], and let $B(F,q)=H^q(X_{\mathrm{et}},\operatorname{ULift} E_F)$, where $E_F$ is the tensor-section sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Give coefficient maps $m(\varphi):\operatorname{ULift}E_F\to\operatorname{ULift}E_G$ for every module map $\varphi:F\to G$. A normalized additive family $c_{F,q}:A(F,q)\to B(F,q)$ is natural in $F$, equals the tensor-pullback unit followed by coefficient lift on degree-zero sections, and commutes with connecting homomorphisms for every short exact sequence of quasi-coherent modules that is exact on the Zariski abelian sheaves and on the coefficient sheaves under $m$. Suppose that for every $F$ and $n\geq0$ there is such a sequence $0\to F\to G\to Q\to0$ with $A(G,n+1)=B(G,n+1)=0$. Then every normalized family is bijective in every degree, and any two normalized families coincide. The definitions Source, Target, Maps, Family, IsNormalized and Effaces spell out these groups and conditions.

source.place: Tags 010S and 010T (universal delta functors), 0BDY Lemma 30.4.3(1) (acyclic embedding), 03P2 and 03FD (cohomology comparison)

proof.text: Evaluate degree-zero cohomology at the terminal objects. The terminal etale structural morphism is an isomorphism, so its tensor-pullback unit is an isomorphism by adjunction uniqueness. The prescribed degree-zero map is therefore bijective, and the normalization gives equality of two families in degree zero.

For uniqueness, induct on the degree simultaneously for every quasi-coherent F. Choose an effacing sequence. The source connecting map is surjective by the long exact sequence and vanishing on G. Write each class as a boundary. Boundary compatibility and the induction hypothesis on Q give equality. Use the covariant Ext exact sequence, with the boundary given by composition with the short exact extension class.

For bijectivity, induct simultaneously on F. Surjectivity follows from the two surjective boundaries and surjectivity on Q in the preceding degree. For injectivity, lift a kernel class through the source boundary to y on Q. Its image in B(Q,n) has zero boundary, hence comes from z on G. Lift z through the preceding-degree comparison on G. Naturality and injectivity on Q show that y lies in the image from G. Source exactness then kills its boundary. Use the covariant Ext exact sequence, with the boundary given by composition with the short exact extension class.

mathlib_searches.query: A normalized morphism from Zariski to etale coherent cohomology extends the identity on sections and commutes with connecting maps; acyclic quasi-coherent embeddings give uniqueness and invertibility
mathlib_searches.results: Eight scheme-normalization declarations, unrelated to cohomology. No match.

mathlib_searches.query: The canonical comparison between Zariski and etale cohomology of quasi coherent modules is the unique morphism of delta functors which is the identity on global sections
mathlib_searches.results: No normalized coherent comparison; library has the generic effaceable delta-functor universal theorem, the acyclic quasi-coherent embedding, and a comparison without a boundary assertion.

Mathlib has no normalized coherent comparison. Source library provides universal delta functors and flat pullback exactness. The existing comparison has naturality and degree-zero normalization but no boundary clause. Its terminal-unit isomorphism lemmas are private.

from.place: Final paragraph: canonical coherent-etale comparison, including its normalization as a morphism of delta functors

theorem normalized_bijective (X : Scheme.{u}) (m : Maps X)
    (efface : Effaces X m)
    (c : Family X) (hc : IsNormalized X m c)
    (hzero : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsQuasicoherent],
      Function.Bijective (c F 0))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (c F q)
